entries.problem: Complex multi-step actions with card interactions
entries.notes: Decision-tree Engine (Seq/Or/Xor/Parallel/Leaf nodes) with card listener hooks (before<Action>, computeReplace<Action>). Ark Nova adds FlowConvertor.php for runtime-generated flows.
Only reference with true simultaneous play: private state machines inside a shared multi-active state, backed by the action command queue.
Earth: command pattern with do()/undo() and reevaluate() for pending-command invalidation. Agricola: gamelog-based snapshot cancellation for turn-based undo.

entries.problem: Turn-based multi-level undo with partial-turn confirmation
entries.notes: Logs every mutation to a log table; undo reverts DB rows and cancels gamelog packets via the cancel column.
Only spatial map system in the references: cube coordinates, adjacency and terrain validation, enclosure management.
Material-driven card definitions plus a single effects class; the right complexity level for medium pools.
One PHP class per card with listener-based reactions scales to any card count.
Marine World integration gated behind runtime flags; new card types, maps, and mechanics without core-flow changes.
Multiple draft modes: Living Hand, 7-of-10, simultaneous async, snake-opening variant.
Appeal + reputation + conservation tracks with dynamic scoring deltas pushed via the listener system.
~30 states, no custom Engine, single developer; the best baseline for learning BGA state machine fundamentals.
Modular client-side Managers, SCSS modules, JSON config files (stats.json, gameoptions.json), annotation-driven DB mapping.
Dual notification pattern: public message + private payload. Earth's private state machine carries hidden state natively.
Full campaign system with persistence across sessions, solo-specific cards, and AI-like mechanics. Earth ships a Gaia solo opponent.
Dedicated tooltip JS class with comprehensive per-item coverage.
Listener/delta system caches values and sends only changed fields. Earth differentiates unconfirmed/committed/undo notifiers.
refreshUI + refreshHand pattern rebroadcasts full state then player-specific hands; gamelog packet cancellation on undo.
Seed loading, Studio debug actions, bug-triage records, dedicated debug states.
